problem_type: Task projections misclassify domain artifacts as actionable media candidates
symptom: A new production draft displays two empty grey candidate blocks for brief and direction text artifacts.
direct_cause: All run artifact IDs were projected as candidates; renderer replaced identity with sequence labels and had no image or adoption handler.
class_root: Task display facts did not preserve domain artifact kind, preview identity and adoption eligibility at the shared projection boundary.
affected_population: Production runs with text artifacts, unavailable previews, unreviewed media or already adopted artifacts
entry_points: V4 candidate display and explicit user adoption
internal_only_reason: The invariant is owned by existing internal ProductionRun artifact projection and review/adoption APIs; no new third-party format or runtime is involved.
invariants: Only existing media with a valid domain preview appears as a candidate.
Adoption availability derives from the domain review rule and execution rechecks the rule.
Task facts remain ephemeral joins; no candidate state is duplicated in transcripts.
generality_proof: Both initial resolve and run-change events project through the same media/preview/eligibility function; v4 carries its identities unchanged and uses the existing domain command.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Converge initial and changed production runs into media-only, preview-backed task facts.
Map a displayed immutable artifact identity to the existing revision-bound domain adoption command.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Initial and reopened sessions resolve task facts by run identity.
Live artifact readiness and adoption changes use the same projection.
Existing task-center previews already filter media and build project-local asset URLs; its review UI remains unchanged.

recurrence.reason: Every text-first run and any future run with missing, rejected or unreviewed media can reproduce the same empty or false action.
same_class_scan: rg candidateIds across lane contracts, view model and runtime task fixtures
Read ProductionRunTaskCard media preview selection and productionRunReducer.canAdoptArtifact
Read productionRunIpc artifact.adopt and productionRunCommands revision recovery

prevention.invariant: Media identity, verified preview and domain eligibility must travel together in task facts.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid or absent previews omit a candidate; unapproved media cannot invoke adoption; stale state is rejected by the domain command.
prevention.strategy: Replace untyped artifact ID projection with domain-derived candidate facts consumed without reconstructing authority in the renderer.

legacy_paths.rationale: The same projection and card implementation are corrected in place; obsolete candidateIds behavior is removed without a parallel code path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing application-owned artifact preview and adoption boundaries are reused; no SDK behavior is changed.

migration: Task facts are ephemeral domain joins; persisted task identity stays unchanged. Update internal typed fixtures with the new projection shape; no user-data rewrite.
residual_risks: Final Electron screenshot and media click must be verified by the shared production runner after integration.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Initial and live domain task facts share the same media-preview-adoption projection.
